about_the_game:
The highly anticipated second volume of the FINAL FANTASY BRAVE EXVIUS original soundtrack is now available!

Three years after the release of Volume 1, this new installment once again features music produced by Noriyasu Agematsu, capturing the grandeur of the game’s world with delicate, beautiful, and powerful compositions.

This soundtrack brings together a collection of new melodies that have colored the new tales of crystals in FINAL FANTASY BRAVE EXVIUS — a journey through sound you won’t want to miss.
